title: Band-9 Samples: What do you do in your neighbourhood in your free time? [Why/why not?]
passage_html:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 2 Test 4 question:

“What do you do in your neighbourhood in your free time? [Why/why not?]”

Sample 1: Doing Something

My neighbourhood boasts an array of walking and biking trails that I often take advantage of during my free time. These scenic routes provide an invigorating way to unwind, exercise, and immerse myself in the natural beauty of the area. Additionally, it offers a chance for quiet contemplation, allowing me to reflect on my thoughts and gain a deeper appreciation for the environment and its calming effects.

Sample 2: Doing Something

Whenever I have some leisure time, I love indulging in culinary adventures by exploring the various eateries and restaurants scattered throughout my neighbourhood. This enables me to discover and appreciate the diverse range of cuisines and flavours our community has to offer, while also supporting local businesses. Moreover, it presents an opportunity to share these gastronomic experiences with friends and family.

Sample 3: Doing Something

My neighbourhood offers a plethora of leisure activities that I take advantage of during my downtime. I find solace in visiting bookshops, where I can expand my intellectual horizons, and appreciate the cinematic arts at nearby movie theatres. Moreover, I savour the convivial atmosphere of cafes, where I can socialize with friends and nurture my creative spirit over a cup of coffee.

Sample 4: Doing Something

In my neighbourhood, I relish the chance to participate in group sports like soccer and volleyball. These activities are held at the nearby park, where people from all walks of life come together to unwind and forge lasting bonds. Playing sports in my locality not only keeps me active and healthy but also nurtures camaraderie and mutual understanding among the residents.

Sample 5: Not Doing Anything

In my free time, I predominantly prefer to stay indoors rather than engaging in any activities in my neighbourhood. The reason behind this inclination is that I find solace in pursuing my hobbies such as reading, painting, and watching movies within the comfort of my home. This allows me to unwind from the daily grind and recharge my batteries, effectively negating the need to venture out into the neighbourhood for leisurely pursuits.

Sample 6: Not Doing Anything

When it comes to spending my leisure time, I seldom participate in neighbourhood activities. My rationale for this stems from my introverted nature and the immense satisfaction I derive from introspective pursuits. I find it more fulfilling to spend my free time meditating, writing in my journal, or exploring new ideas through online courses, rather than indulging in outdoor activities within the vicinity of my residence.

Sample 7: Not Doing Anything

Honestly, I don’t partake in any activities within my neighbourhood during my free time, as I find it rather monotonous and lacking in variety. To me, leisure time is an opportunity to explore new places and experiences, so I often venture out to other parts of the city or even nearby towns to invigorate my senses and broaden my horizons.

Sample 8: Not Doing Anything

I rarely participate in any activities within my neighbourhood during my downtime, as my work schedule is quite demanding. Consequently, I find it more prudent to allocate my limited free time to personal and familial responsibilities. Attending to my loved ones and maintaining a well-balanced life take precedence over engaging in neighbourhood events or gatherings.

Sample 9: It Depends

Well, it depends on various factors like the weather, my mood, and availability of my friends. When the weather is pleasant, I relish taking leisurely strolls around the park, which offers a rejuvenating atmosphere. Sometimes, I join my friends for a game of basketball at the local court. However, if I am in a contemplative mood, I might just find solace in visiting the quaint little library tucked away in a corner of my neighbourhood.

Sample 10: It Depends

The manner in which I spend my free time in the neighbourhood is closely tied to my work-life balance. If I’ve had a particularly taxing week at work, I might choose to visit a nearby spa for some much-needed rejuvenation or spend a quiet evening at a local cinema, catching the latest movie. In contrast, if my professional life has been less demanding, I may be more inclined to socialize and forge connections within the community, perhaps by joining a local hobby club or volunteering at a neighborhood event.
